recaps.title: Sample: 2025 Week 1 Recap
recaps.dateLabel: Sample format — last season’s Week 1 finals (not 2026)
recaps.coldOpen: Welcome to IDP country, where 220 is a Tuesday and 250 is a personality. Week 1 reminded everyone: offense sells tickets, defense runs up the scoreboard. Hero of the week: anybody with a green jersey and a tackle. Goat of the week: whoever brought a Fantrax projection to a gunfight.
heroes: Myles Garrett (TTAB) — 42 on DL, ruined someone’s Sunday
S. Dennis (Eddies) — 35 IDP, the quiet assassin
goats: Saltese’s Week 1 script — 184.5 while Bill hit 244
The Big Unit — 173 in a league that averages 220+
Anyone who started the week trusting Fantrax IDP math

matchups.scoreline: Towner Top Aga Bottom 254.5, Indian Trail Slumlords 251.5
matchups.blurb: Three points. THREE. Allen dropped 50, Garrett dropped 42, and Towner still needed every tackle-assist to survive Gibbs & Co. Closest game of the week — if your heart rate didn’t spike, you’re lying.
Kyle wins ugly, as is tradition. Puka did Puka things; Tim’s IDP (Okereke 32) almost stole it. Dual-era champ energy: never pretty, always enough.
Bill’s defense threw a house party (Dennis 35, Brooks 31) while Luke’s offense filed a missing-persons report. Commish gets the early reminder: the rings don’t care about your title.
Ceiling check: Hot Coffee’s IDP put up 161 by itself. Mack, Warner, Watt — that’s not a defense, that’s a tax audit. 219.5 would win most leagues. Here it’s a polite loss.

matchups.scoreline: The Longest Yard 218.5, The Big Unit 173
matchups.blurb: Alumni energy. One team remembered tackles are points; the other brought a 173 to a 220 fight. If your IDP week looks like The Big Unit, start making waiver friends.

recaps.closer: Template for Tuesdays: cold open → every scoreline with smack → heroes/goats. First live 2026 drop lands after Week 1 finals (Tue 9/15). WWJDD.
